title:
Your idea.
Your next take.
points: A local-phone director for solo creators
Start with one outfit, one location
narration: Meet Mini Film Director: the idea of a local phone app that helps solo creators plan, perform, and shape their content.

title:
Tell it what
you want to make.
narration: Start with your objective. Here, we want a twenty-second jacket reveal, with texture, a walk, and a confident final pose.

title:
Borrow a structure.
Make it your own.
narration: Review the reference shots, then choose what to borrow: timing, angles, or posing. This example is invented; no Instagram reel was downloaded.

title:
You approve
the new plan.
points: Confirm before replacing the shot list
Keep your objective and existing takes
narration: Use as my shot plan asks for confirmation. Your objective, opening line, and existing takes stay with your project.

title:
Five clear shots.
Twenty seconds.
points: Edit a cue or duration before starting
narration: The result is five editable shots. Adjust any cue or duration. Applying a plan does not begin recording.

title:
One instruction
at a time.
narration: Press Start this shoot. The director gives one posing cue at a time. Spoken guidance is optional.

title:
Ready.
Three, two, one.
narration: Then comes the countdown. Three, two, one. You always have a Stop control.

title:
Perform.
The director keeps time.
points: Stop cancels future takes and cues
narration: Action begins a timed sample take. In this web demo, the image is an illustration, not a live camera.

title:
Cut.
On to the next shot.
narration: Cut saves the sample draft, then the sequence moves to the next shot.

title:
Review first.
Then shape the edit.
points: Five takes enter the editable timeline
narration: When the shoot finishes, your takes appear in Edit. Review the sequence, then trim or reorder clips.

title:
Your words.
Your final say.
points: Choose your cover and sound direction
narration: Captions, sound direction, and the cover remain editable. These web captions are samples, rather than a transcription result.

title:
Save the project.
Keep it editable.
points: Name and explicitly save your film
Keep the brief, shots, and edit together
narration: Name your film and save it explicitly. The project keeps your brief, shots, captions, and edit decisions together.

title:
Come back.
Pick up where you left off.
narration: Projects holds your saved films in this browser. Reopen one, or download its JSON backup. This website does not export a video.

title:
Built toward
a local-phone loop.
points: Full local loop and phone latency: pending
narration: The local-phone vision combines Qwen with small speech models. Separate Android CPU inference has been tested; the complete speech and vision loop still needs validation.

title:
Plan it.
Shoot it. Make it yours.
eyebrow: GUIDED DEMO IDEA / MINI FILM DIRECTOR
narration: Mini Film Director. A pre-event design prototype, showing how a solo creator could move from an idea to a reviewed film.
